title: Assess the Effects of Replacing Foods High in Refined Carbohydrates With Avocado on Biomarkers of Inflammation.
official: Effects of Avocado Consumption on Inflammation and Insulin Sensitivity in Adults With Elevated High Sensitivity-C-reactive Protein (Hs-CRP): A Randomized, Controlled Crossover Trial
summary: The objective of this trial is to assess the effects of replacing foods high in refined carbohydrates, particularly added sugars, with avocado (isocaloric substitution) on biomarkers of inflammation and insulin sensitivity in adults with elevated hs-CRP and central adiposity. Eligible participants will complete two 4-week interventions (1 avocado/d and control) separated by a 2-week washout phase. Participants will complete a total of 7 clinic visits including one screening visit (visit 1, -7 days), one baseline visit (visit 2, day 0), two visits during each 4-week diet condition (visit 3 \& 6 on day 21 and visits 4 \& 7 on day 28), and one visit at the conclusion of the washout phase/start of the second condition (visit 5, day 0).
sponsor: Midwest Center for Metabolic and Cardiovascular Research
